document.title: Public distrust of scientists
document.question:
In many countries, a growing number of people say that they do not trust scientists and prefer to rely on information from friends or social media. Some believe scientists themselves are partly to blame, while others point to the spread of false information online.

What are the causes of this problem, and what can be done to restore public trust in science?

Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience.
